Hi Francia,

Thank you for sharing. 

I tried to upload your image in R and it worked fine.

You are able to follow FIELDimageR pipeline: rotate, draw shapefiles, and extract data. 

Here is the code:

library(raster)
EX1<-stack("DJI_0024_R.JPG")
plot(EX1)
plotRGB(EX1, r = 1, g = 2, b = 3)



All the best,
Filipe
